bends.note: jog, north point: the 60' street (centre x 440, R.R. track down its middle) stops at the R.R. siding
jog, south point: south of the siding Valley continues only as a 10' passage along its west side (centre x 316-326) to Harrison
angle point: Harrison rises ENE west of here (towards Western/Mill Creek) and runs ESE east of here to Spring Grove; curbs and both water pipes break here

notes: Valley at the left edge: 60' wide from Queen City down to the R.R. siding of the Joseph Joseph & Bro. junk yard; south of the siding only a 10' passage (lots 2212/2200 face it) reaches Harrison. Harrison/Western is at the binding gutter (Western's west curb runs into the fold; point placed from the east curb and the water pipe), so less precise. The street leaving Harrison southward at x 3834-4148 (about 50', water pipe) is not named on this sheet or the key map: '?'. Spring Grove (100') meets Harrison from the north; the street continuing south (100', centre about 180 px further east) is McLean Av per the key map (unlabelled here; the key map labels it McLEAN AV. south of Harrison, becoming Division further south), so recorded as two offset T's. Queen City east of Spring Grove is narrower (about 48') and turns slightly; the Queen City/Spring Grove point is the centre of the four corners.
